category-flat.profile_description: One folder per client, subdivided by document category rather than by advice event. This is how most practice-management systems (Xplan, AdviserLogic, Practifi, Virtual Cabinet) organise a client file, so it is the profile to start from when filing into one. Advice events are still computed and still drive the flags and the event links. They are recorded in the manifest rather than in the folder path, so nothing is lost; it is just not expressed as folders.

sharepoint-safe.profile_description: ASCII only, no characters SharePoint or OneDrive reject or mangle, and a shorter path budget. SharePoint URL-encodes the path, so a name that is legal on disk can still blow the server limit once encoded; this profile keeps well inside it. Use for any sync-based destination, including Teams document libraries.
